description.value: A 24-hour McDonald's drive-through and dine-in location on Main Street in Vancouver, offering the full Canadian McDonald's menu including breakfast, McCafé beverages, and vegetarian options. Situated in a standalone retail building, this location is convenient for cyclists passing through the Main Street corridor. Indoor seating is available.
